title: Knowledge or intelligence release manifest (KNOWLEDGE_RELEASE.json)
description: Component manifest of a knowledge release or an intelligence (model) release. It travels inside an ordinary signed contract-v1 bundle: RELEASE.json, SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.sig are unchanged, and this file is listed in SHA256SUMS, so the owner's Ed25519 release signature covers it transitively. Every component declares the full state it produces (result_digest), so a delta changes only what is transported, never what is verified. Application releases (installer, binaries) are never described here, and installation-specific data (users, sessions, audit, local uploads, local withdrawals, Document Studio, exclusion store) can never be a component. See docs/architecture/c16/C16_KNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_ARCHITECTURE.md.

release_sequence.description: Equal to RELEASE.json release_sequence. Knowledge and intelligence releases share the v1 sequence space of the release channel, so replay protection is unchanged.

base.description: FULL: self-contained. DELTA: applies only on top of base_release_id, which must be the ACTIVE release at import (v1 compatibility.previous_release_id).

corpus_generations.description: Producer corpus generations (C16 corpus_generation_id) this release is built from.

knowledge_format.description: Layout of the knowledge generation on site (major.minor).

contracts.description: Contract versions of the records inside (v1 contract_version, corpus contract).

pg_knowledge_schema_version.description: Version of the knowledge DDL the PostgreSQL data archive loads into. The DDL ships with the application, never in the archive.

graph_builder_version.description: GraphBuilder.Version the prebuilt graph was produced with (e.g. c15-graph-1). A different application builder version rebuilds the graph locally (cheap) instead of using the prebuilt rows.

index_format.description: Persistent lexical index format (ADR-0007 MANIFEST format).

required_models.description: Models whose exact bytes must be installed (by an intelligence release) for the vector and ranking components to be usable. A knowledge release never changes models.

heavy_compute_on_site.description: Declares which expensive steps the site must run to activate. A knowledge release built per this architecture declares NONE for all three: text, vectors for the installed model and the graph are shipped. A model-change intelligence release ships full vector packs for the new model, so it too needs no embedding on site.

kind.description: ORIGINALS: vault objects (content-addressed, add-only). TEXT_DERIVATIVES: [[page N]] derived text by text sha256. RECORDS: canonical JSONL record sets (v1 and C16). PG_KNOWLEDGE_DATA: pg_dump custom-format, data-only archive of the knowledge schema. LEXICAL_INDEX: ADR-0007 search.sqlite + MANIFEST.json. VECTOR_PACK: MIMVEC01 vectors for one model sha. GRAPH: graph nodes/edges with the GraphStore digest. RESEARCH_AIDS: signed research JSONL (A4 provision versions, lexicon). INTEGRITY_REGISTER: per-copy hash verification results. ADMISSION_REGISTER: C16 corpus_admission records. MODEL_FILE, RULE_PACK: intelligence release only.

authority.description: AUTHORITATIVE: the site's source of truth (originals, records, derived text, registers). ACCELERATOR: derived from authoritative components by a deterministic, versioned builder and shipped only to save site compute; the site verifies it against its declared digest and, if it cannot use it, rebuilds or degrades, never the other way round.

transport.description: FULL: the files carry the whole component. DELTA: the files carry additions (and tombstones for record sets) against the base release's component of the same id; the result must hash to result_digest.

result_digest.description: SHA-256 over the component's canonical content after applying (component-specific definition in the architecture, section 5).

source_digest.description: ACCELERATOR only: the digest of the authoritative inputs it was built from (ADR-0007 source digest; GraphStore digest inputs; vector keys).

model_sha256.description: VECTOR_PACK and MODEL_FILE: the model the vectors belong to / the model file hash.

verify.description: Checks the site must run before activation (all of them; any failure refuses the release or, for an ACCELERATOR, falls back as stated).

fallback.description: ACCELERATOR only: what the site does if the accelerator cannot be used.

transport.description: The vault is add-only: originals are never removed by a release (withdrawal is the exclusion channel).
